messages:
ben: Kicking off staged geocut for v2.4.1 — order: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 23:30-03:30 UTC. Requesting capacity confirmations and reserve checks. Deploy bot ready.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy start requested: v2.4.1 -> service/redwood-inference (staged canary: 4% -> 20% -> 100%). Commit: a3f9d2b. Canary targets: us-central1 4% first.

hana: APAC reserve pool status? last quarter APAC cold start hit tail spikes. Need GPU reserve >= 18 nodes before APAC canary.

tomas: APAC reserve target = 18, current active = 12, booting 6 (estimated 6m). EU reserve target = 28, current active = 28.

mike: propose we proceed with US only until APAC reserve ready. EU canary can go after US if EU metrics stable for 15m.

anya: rollback triggers (set): error_rate delta > 1.5% over baseline sustained 4m OR p99 latency > 1.2s sustained 4m OR gpu_mem_util > 85% sustained 3m. Auto-pin target = previous stable v2.3.9.

ben: Agreed. US canary go. EU hold to 0% until US green for 15m. APAC blocked until reserve >= 95%.

deploy-bot: US canary applied 4%. Running smoke checks...
```
[deploy-bot] smoke: 8/8 checks passed
[metrics] p95: 420ms p99: 780ms
[metrics] cpu: 22% gpu_mem: 54%
```

mike: US looks clean. move to 20% after 10m if no gaps.

deploy-bot: US canary -> 20% complete. Monitoring. No roll triggers.

hana: APAC reserve now 17/18 (94%). ETA ~60s to hit 18. holding.

tomas: reserve at 18/18. APAC ready.

deploy-bot: Scheduling EU canary at 5% (europe-west). EU smoke running.

anya: note: EU has slightly higher request fanout; keep an eye on queue growth. Route policy: if EU load>queue_threshold for 3m, shift slice to US read replica.

deploy-bot: EU smoke results: 7/8 checks passed (one transient startup timeout). metrics:
```
[metrics] p95: 610ms p99: 1.05s
[metrics] error_rate: 0.9%
[deploy-bot] warning: model pull slow on node eu-west-3, retrying
```

mike: that model pull warn is suspicious but transient. give 2 retries. if persists >6m escalate.

ben: hold APAC start until EU stable for 10m. APAC will be last in order.

deploy-bot: EU stable for 9m and counting. No rollback triggers so far.

(deploy-bot scheduled APAC canary to start in 5m)

APAC start: deploy-bot: apac canary 3% in ap-northeast1 started. Running smoke.

hana: seeing p99 jump in APAC to 1.6s after first burst, also GPU mem creeping to 78%. Not yet at trigger but watching.

mike: curious if cross-region cold fetches from model registry caused this. Any model cache misses?

tomas: logs show model shard fetchs on 2 APAC nodes during initial spin, caused ~300ms extra. caching should fix for next spin.

deploy-bot: APAC smoke: 6/8 checks passed. p99 1.6s, error_rate 1.7%. According to triggers, error_rate < 1.5% threshold but p99 > 1.2s so threshold exceeded -> initiating region pause and notify.

anya: initiating APAC pause. APAC traffic frozen at current slice. Routing policy: route new APAC traffic to us-central1 until we clear. Pin strategy: if remediation takes >12m, pin APAC to v2.3.9.

ben: copy. Start remediation: (1) warm additional local model cache +1 replica, (2) re-run model pull with higher parallelism, (3) replay a subset of requests to test.

mike: EU trend now creeping p99 to 1.25s over last 3m. I'm going to pin EU back to v2.3.9 manually to avoid customer impact. Doing the pin now.

deploy-bot: Manual pin executed: region=EU pinned -> v2.3.9. Rolling back canary slice in EU. Traffic rerouted to us-central1 for EU-origin sessions per route policy.

anya: executed rollback playbook steps; uploaded artifacts and note in runbook. Will monitor for 20m then decide next action.

ben: thanks. APAC remediation progress?

tomas: added cache replica, model pull retry succeeded, p99 dropping to 980ms, gpu_mem 60%.

deploy-bot: APAC canary resumed at 3% after remediation. New smoke pass: 8/8 checks passed. p99 740ms.

mike: great. After APAC 20m green, we'll do full ramp. EU remains pinned until we validate v2.4.1 fixes for model pull.

ben: release notes draft for external changelog (mike please review): "v2.4.1: reduced long-tail latency for multimodal workflows, better shard caching during cold starts, API-stable quantization toggle."

mike: looks good. add note about regional staged rollout and temporary EU pin for safety.

deploy-bot: US/EU/APAC final ramp scheduled. Current status: US=100% (deployed), EU=pinned=v2.3.9, APAC=20% progressing.

anya: ops follow-ups: tighten model-pull concurrency default, add regional cache warm hooks, and reduce APAC boot cooldown from 10m -> 6m. I'll file tickets.

ben: awesome work everyone. Closing thread after final checks. Postmortem to include timeline and the EU pin reason. :confetti_ball:
